full_prompt_en: A square cinematic photograph shows a solitary man seated in a narrow, cluttered interior lined with books and stacked objects. He sits near the center-right, facing the camera with a serious, slightly questioning expression. Dark, loosely waved hair falls around his face, and he wears a charcoal jacket over a black shirt. His hands and lower body are mostly hidden by the table and dim foreground. The left wall is crowded with books, papers, narrow shelves, and vertical objects, all receding sharply toward a dark back room. Much of the near left foreground is heavily blurred, with cream and brown shapes that frame the seated figure and make the room feel crowded. Behind him, a green-gray wall carries mottled patches and indistinct small pictures or marks. A low tabletop extends across the lower middle, piled with flat papers and small objects that remain partly in shadow. The brightest area falls on the man's face and the nearby shelf edges, while the upper right and back of the room sink into green-black darkness. Light appears to come through an opening from the left front, filtered and cool, catching the cheek and hair without producing a hard cast shadow. Narrow warm highlights on the papers and wood prevent the palette from becoming wholly cold. Shallow depth of field keeps the man readable while the foreground and farther shelves soften at different depths. Fine grain and subdued color reinforce the worn, enclosed atmosphere. The overall composition places a still human figure within a dense corridor of objects, balancing intimate focus against the pressure of surrounding shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影式照片呈现一位男子独自坐在狭窄而拥挤的室内，两侧堆满书本与杂物。他位于中央偏右，面向镜头，神情严肃而略带疑问。深色微卷头发垂在脸旁，他穿炭灰外套和黑衬衫。双手与下半身大都被桌子和暗前景遮住。左墙挤着书、纸、窄架和竖直物件，快速向深暗的后室退去。左前景大部分严重失焦，奶油和棕色形体为坐着的男子框景，也让房间显得拥挤。其后灰绿色墙面带斑驳色块和模糊的小图或标记。一片低桌面横过下方中央，堆着薄纸和小物件，部分仍在阴影里。最亮区域落在男子面部和附近书架边缘，右上和房间后部则沉入绿黑色。光似乎从左前方的开口透入，经过过滤而偏冷，照到脸颊与头发，却没有形成硬投影。纸张和木材上的狭窄暖高光防止配色完全变冷。浅景深让男子可读，前景和更远架子以不同程度柔化。细颗粒与压低的色彩加强磨旧封闭的氛围。整体构图把一个静止人影放在密集物件通道里，以亲近焦点平衡周围阴影的压力。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic photograph uses a deep green-black palette, selective cool light, and warm narrow highlights. Near forms blur strongly, the central focal zone remains legible, and rear layers fade into mottled shadow. Fine grain and worn surface detail give the dark image a tactile rather than glossy finish. Dense vertical marks crowd one side of the frame and direct attention toward a quieter central area. Light enters from an oblique opening, modeling the focus softly while leaving the outer space unresolved. The result feels enclosed, deliberate, and quietly suspenseful.
style_prompt_zh: 这种电影式摄影使用深绿黑色调、有选择性的冷光和狭窄暖高光。近处形体强烈模糊，中央焦点区域保持可辨，后层逐渐淡入斑驳阴影。细颗粒与磨旧表面细节让暗画面可触，而非光亮。密集竖线挤在画面一侧，把注意引向较安静的中央区域。光从斜向开口进入，柔和塑造焦点，外围空间仍不完全可辨。结果封闭、克制而暗含悬念。
theme_en: A solitary man seated among crowded shelves in a dim room
theme_zh: 一位男子独坐在昏暗房间的拥挤书架之间
name: Park Chan Wook
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
